description: 1.2 — Victory, capture units, and capturing structures.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: How to win ◦ Each player has a Command Structure. ◦ Capture the enemy's Command Structure while protecting your own.◦ Use BISMUTH income to grow an army that can contest the map.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Capture units Only certain units — capture units — can seize BISMUTH sites and other structures: ◦ Ertrian Infantry ◦ Virix Spore ◦ Sentus BlacksmithBring the right unit to the objective.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Capturing structures ◦ Move a capture unit onto a structure and start capture. ◦ Structures have 200 HP while contested.◦ At full health, completing a capture takes two turns — pressure your opponent before they stabilize the line.
